ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
075
Behind the image
29 / Clean Slate
REFERENCE 5791.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 024
Art direction: Raw casting-photo minimalism, no retouching feel, soft flat daylight, neutral palette.
Photorealistic casting-style portrait of an original adult woman with dark hair slicked back damp
with a center part and two small tied knots at the top, light freckles, pale gray-blue eyes, strong
natural brows, bare skin with no makeup and neutral pink lips. She faces the camera straight on
with a calm, serious expression, shoulders square, wearing a white ribbed fitted short-sleeve top.
Plain pale gray wall, soft even daylight, true-to-life skin texture with natural pores, minimal
retouching, sharp focus on the eyes, no text or logos.
30 / Indigo Ridge
REFERENCE 5790.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 025
Art direction: Folk-inspired mountain heritage, deep indigo against warm stone, soft overcast
travel-editorial light.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter travel editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with
long, straight dark hair and soft wispy bangs, rosy blush on her cheeks and a calm, composed
gaze. She wears a handmade navy indigo-dyed wrap jacket with a red and white embroidered
collar, a cream fabric waist sash tied with blue cords, a finely pleated dark skirt with bright blue
and orange woven hem bands, a dark velvet choker and small drop earrings. She stands in front of
an old rounded-stone wall covered in moss and leaves in a mountain village. Soft overcast natural
light, shallow depth of field, rich indigo blue against warm earthy stone tones, medium-format film
look, authentic cultural-heritage fashion mood, no text or logos.
